lcc_original: 該隱對他的兄弟亞伯【3】說：『我們出去到田間吧。【3】二人正在田間，該隱就起來打他的兄弟亞伯，把他殺了。
notes: WH0413 (אֶל, preposition 'to/against') maps to 對 in the first clause and to 打 in the second, following UNV's mapping convention where 打 renders the directional-object marker of 'rose up against' (וַיָּקָם אֶל).
LCC includes the expanded quotation '我們出去到田間吧' reflecting the Samaritan/LXX reading absent from MT; UNV+SN has no SN tags for this content, so it is left unannotated.

{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (= וַיְהִי, narrative wayyiqtol of הָיָה) remains implicit — LCC conveys the clause transition through sentence structure rather than an explicit word, so no explicit host is available.
LCC 就 (Chinese connective aspect marker) is left unannotated; it has no Hebrew equivalent.
The 【3】 footnote markers are preserved exactly in their original positions.
